registration_boundary: Only create learning-request-v1 with actual first native launch/log/thread binding; no fabricated original_log or own run anchors. Revisions/continuations retain original identity.

plans.merge_scope: issue50 item4; reuse scientific parent, no duplicate study
plans.selection: Ended valid unmodified single-player Silent A10 reaching actual F48; verify F48/F49 terminal and boss semantics from schema; compare F49 win/loss, retain censoring/exclusions.
plans.forbidden_substitution: No terminal deck/potions treated as entry snapshot; missing entry state remains missing; no final-victory shortcut for unverified F49 outcome.

plans.selection: Per-act actual boss encounter winner/loss cohorts; freeze encountered boss identity, act/floor and timing.
features_at_decision: act-end winner/loss deck snapshots distinctly labeled
HP/potions/card count and recorded card mechanics
plans.forbidden_substitution: No act-end knowledge assumed available before boss; no comparisons across mixed boss/act/version.

shared_requirements.versions: v0.111 separate from v0.107-v0.110, preserve exact game builds and actual filtered denominators; do not inherit issue intro/sample counts
shared_requirements.privacy: Never read/select/serialize player identifiers or sensitive fields. Explicit safe-column projection only, no SELECT *, no raw database dump or raw public redistribution. Do not use player-ID adjustment/dedup as a workaround; record resulting limitation.
shared_requirements.evidence: Game interpretation and strategy written by learner from supplied evidence; no ops-authored card/HP thresholds. Merge same situations; preserve own/external separation, counterexamples, selection bias, upload/SL/death censoring, player-skill confounding and missingness.
outputs: rk candidates through original issue28 replay gate; not bypassed for speed
shared_requirements.delivery: Each batch separately evaluated/published/read back; report/pipeline completion is not live/consumer/natural use/benefit or science-parent completion.

execution.cli_only: -c service_tier=ultrafast; never config.toml or unrelated sessions
execution.quota: >70% weekly => fast; >85% => default and notify Roy, using actual original usage receipt; no false effective-tier claim
verification: wall time and recorded usage per batch
actual kb_strategies nonempty hits and external references, no A/B

provenance.compressed_hash_basis: issue #24 acquisition receipt; compressed file not re-downloaded
provenance.license: No explicit dataset redistribution license found on public FAQ; aggregate statistics with attribution only; no raw redistribution.
provenance.filter: character='SILENT' AND ascension=10 AND n_players=1 AND is_valid=1 AND was_abandoned=0 AND has_modifiers=0
